pages.title: EmploymentUpdateListener
pages.body:
# EmploymentUpdateListener

Processes member employment changes from MemberPortal through Boomi into Salesforce contact employment fields and NetSuite member attributes.

Use the dependency map and the reported business function to select this process. Correlate the incident time with at least one affected customer/member identifier. An integration boundary failure is a routing lead, not a proven root cause or permission to remediate.

## Process overview

Process ID: proc-e1a2b3c4
Business function: Employment History
Also known as: employment history, employment details, employer update, professional history legacy screen
Source systems: MemberPortal
Destination systems: Salesforce, NetSuite
Trigger: MemberPortal member-action event
Environment: Production
Atom name: IntegrationAtom-PROD
Owning team: CRMTeam
Runtime owner: IntegrationTeam

## Documented flow

1. Receive the member employment-change event.
2. Query and validate Salesforce contact/employment data; apply the employment update.
3. Synchronize the resulting employment attributes to the NetSuite member account.

## Screen coverage

Both the current employment form and the Professional history legacy screen submit employment updates to this process. The legacy screen is an older presentation of the same capability.

## Investigating an incident

Log location: boomi_logs/employment_update_listener/ (one file per execution)

Correlate execution evidence using incident time and an affected-person identifier. Query Inspect Boomi Log Tool with Process ID, incident_timestamp and customer_id, member_id, customer_email or customer_name. Read all returned execution IDs, matched document IDs and identity-line references. Logs use five tab-separated columns: timestamp, level, shape, detail, message. A custom Document context Notify step logs documentId, customerId, memberId, email and customerName as JSON. Other lines identify documents by document ID. Complete batch logs can include other customers and recovered errors; only errors linked to the affected document and incident support routing. Inspect connector responses and exceptions even when execution status is COMPLETE.

## Known failure examples

- Salesforce validation or missing external-ID errors.
- NetSuite missing external-ID errors or connector timeouts.

## Related documentation

Access Layer: syn-acc-001. Dependency map: syn-dep-001.

pages.title: ContactDetailsSyncProcess
pages.body:
# ContactDetailsSyncProcess

Processes member contact and profile changes from MemberPortal, updating Salesforce contacts, NetSuite billing/customer fields and Sitecore profile display fields.

Use the dependency map and the reported business function to select this process. Correlate the incident time with at least one affected customer/member identifier. An integration boundary failure is a routing lead, not a proven root cause or permission to remediate.

## Process overview

Process ID: proc-h4d5e6f7
Business function: Member Profile / Contact Details
Also known as: member profile, customer attributes, contact details, address, phone, email address
Source systems: MemberPortal
Destination systems: Salesforce, NetSuite, Sitecore
Trigger: MemberPortal member-action event
Environment: Production
Atom name: IntegrationAtom-PROD
Owning team: CRMTeam
Runtime owner: IntegrationTeam

## Documented flow

1. Receive a contact/profile update from MemberPortal.
2. Query or enrich Salesforce data and update the contact.
3. Synchronize billing/customer fields to NetSuite.
4. Refresh Sitecore profile display fields after the upstream updates.

## Investigating an incident

Log location: boomi_logs/contact_details_sync/ (one file per execution)

Correlate execution evidence using incident time and an affected-person identifier. Query Inspect Boomi Log Tool with Process ID, incident_timestamp and customer_id, member_id, customer_email or customer_name. Read all returned execution IDs, matched document IDs and identity-line references. Logs use five tab-separated columns: timestamp, level, shape, detail, message. A custom Document context Notify step logs documentId, customerId, memberId, email and customerName as JSON. Other lines identify documents by document ID. Complete batch logs can include other customers and recovered errors; only errors linked to the affected document and incident support routing. Inspect connector responses and exceptions even when execution status is COMPLETE.

## Known failure examples

- Duplicate email or validation failure in Salesforce.
- Missing customer external ID in NetSuite.
- Sitecore API 503.
- Enrichment retries and audit-delivery errors may recover; distinguish these from a blocking write failure.

## Related documentation

Access Layer: syn-acc-001. Dependency map: syn-dep-001.

pages.title: Listener - ecr Order Update
pages.body:
# Listener - ecr Order Update

Receives incoming ECR orders and posts cash-sale records to NetSuite. This legacy order process is separate from the supplied member-action mappings. Use its documented ECR/cash-sale business function to select it. Match the incident time and an available affected customer/member identifier before interpreting evidence. Read connector responses and exceptions as well as the final execution status. An integration boundary failure identifies a routing lead, not a proven root cause or authorization to remediate.

## Process overview

Process ID: proc-k7g8h9i0
Business function: Order Processing
Also known as: ecr, cash sale, order update
Related terminology: ecr, cash sale, order update, ECR, NetSuite
Source systems: ECR
Destination systems: NetSuite
Trigger: ECR order queue
Environment: CA ANZ PROD
Responsible group: GRP-BOOMI

## Purpose

Receives incoming ECR orders and posts cash-sale records to NetSuite.

## Documented flow

1. Receive an incoming ECR order from the order queue.
2. Retrieve supplemental order/product information.
3. Submit the cash-sale record to NetSuite and inspect its response.

## Investigating an incident

Log availability: No retained execution logs for this process in the saved-scenario fixtures. The documented process remains a candidate; log lookup can return no matching executions.

Correlate execution evidence using incident time and an available affected-person identifier. Retrieve executions overlapping the incident window using customer_id, member_id, customer_email or customer_name. Read the returned execution IDs, matched document IDs and identity-line references. Logs use five tab-separated columns: timestamp, level, shape, detail, message. A custom Document context Notify step logs documentId, customerId, memberId, email and customerName as JSON. Other lines identify documents by document ID without repeating personal information. Complete batch logs can include other customers and recovered errors; only errors linked to the affected document and incident support routing.

## Known failure examples

- NetSuite API returns success=false with an error message.

## Related documentation

Access Layer: syn-acc-001. Dependency map: syn-dep-001.

pages.title: MembershipRenewalOrchestrator
pages.body:
# MembershipRenewalOrchestrator

Coordinates membership renewal and upgrade checkout from MemberPortal, payment processing, Salesforce membership/order changes, NetSuite order/invoice records and confirmation notification.

Use the dependency map and the reported business function to select this process. Correlate the incident time with at least one affected customer/member identifier. An integration boundary failure is a routing lead, not a proven root cause or permission to remediate.

## Process overview

Process ID: proc-f2b3c4d5
Business function: Membership Renewal / Checkout
Also known as: membership renewal, upgrade, checkout, proceed to checkout, sales order
Source systems: MemberPortal
Destination systems: PaymentGateway, Salesforce, NetSuite, NotificationService
Trigger: MemberPortal member-action event
Environment: Production
Atom name: IntegrationAtom-PROD
Owning team: ERPTeam
Runtime owner: IntegrationTeam

## Documented flow

1. Receive the membership renewal or upgrade checkout event.
2. Request payment processing through PaymentGateway.
3. Update Salesforce membership/order data.
4. Create or update the related NetSuite sales order and invoice records.
5. Request a confirmation through NotificationService; notification failure is nonblocking.

## Evidence scope

The retained executions model the Salesforce/NetSuite checkout portion of this orchestration. They contain no observations about PaymentGateway or NotificationService availability. Unresolved errors at both supported platforms require manual review.

## Investigating an incident

Log location: boomi_logs/membership_renewal_orchestrator/ (one file per execution)

Correlate execution evidence using incident time and an affected-person identifier. Query Inspect Boomi Log Tool with Process ID, incident_timestamp and customer_id, member_id, customer_email or customer_name. Read all returned execution IDs, matched document IDs and identity-line references. Logs use five tab-separated columns: timestamp, level, shape, detail, message. A custom Document context Notify step logs documentId, customerId, memberId, email and customerName as JSON. Other lines identify documents by document ID. Complete batch logs can include other customers and recovered errors; only errors linked to the affected document and incident support routing. Inspect connector responses and exceptions even when execution status is COMPLETE.

## Known failure examples

- PaymentGateway timeout: external dependency requiring human investigation.
- Salesforce order locking or validation errors.
- NetSuite rejected order writes, duplicate invoices or connector timeouts.
- Notification warnings do not establish a failed renewal.

## Related documentation

Access Layer: syn-acc-001. Dependency map: syn-dep-001.
